The '''Magravia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Karthakk sector/Legends|Karthakk sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Magravia]], a notable [[Spice/Legends|spice]] producer.<ref name="TEA" />
